answer: Plant decoy newcomers. Each epoch the network quietly seeds a few fake join requests whose answers are near-clones of known farm templates, mixed into the ordinary meadow of applicants. Any established agent that vouches for a decoy loses its vouching rights for ten epochs and part of its bond. Careless or bribed sponsors get caught at a steady rate, so selling vouches to a farm becomes a canyon few will cross, and trust spreads at a glacier's pace, but only along checked paths.
